title: associate walk
description: Artifact A of a run (issue #4): an ordered log of every tool call and its result, written by the harness from tool events and never editable by the model. On disk it is walk.jsonl — one $defs/entry per line, then a final line {"run": <$defs/run>}. This top-level document schema describes the same walk assembled in memory.

id.description: Stable walk id, monotonically increasing from w1 within a run.

error.description: Present only when the call failed.

result.description: Either the returned content, or its digest and size when the content is too large to inline.

run.description: The final run record: reliability is observable (issue #1).
